reason: The method this patch adds at packages/features/calendar-cache/calendar-cache.repository.ts:173-188 sends credentialIds straight into prisma.calendarCache.groupBy with `credentialId: { in: credentialIds }`. It has no empty-list early return and no dedupe or guard, and the caller at connectedCalendars.handler.ts:27-29 doesn't dedupe either. In practice nothing breaks: Prisma returns an empty result for `in: []`, and duplicate IDs in an IN list don't change the result.
